idea-plugin.name: KCommon Config YAML Support
idea-plugin.description: Understands the KCommon module/config system: locates the module that a <module-id>/config.yml belongs to, resolves the Java field each YAML key maps to, and uses that to flag unrecognized keys and suggest valid values for enum-like fields (e.g. XMaterial, XSound, or any plain enum). Resolution is best-effort and silent whenever a module or field type can't be determined. Config schemas can also be exported to a JSON file and imported into another project, so a lone YAML file opened outside its project (e.g. downloaded for remote/SFTP editing) still gets full completion and validation. A file or section can declare its module explicitly with a `#@Module`/`#@File` comment tag, and a specific key/value pair's type can be pinned with `#$Type`, both with their own smart completion.
